text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah, sold out~! Did all the ingredients 
run out!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously!? Aren't we the fastest 
around!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
What a shame... I really wanted to try at 
least one bite from this place...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —No! It's okay! I can still make it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Besides, there are still 
plenty of vegetables in the field that are 
ripe for eating!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Please wait just a teeny-tiny second! I'll 
get ready at super-speed right now!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, mind watching the place for a 
bit! Alright, everyone! Let's roll!

It was a roaring success...! She managed 
to garner enough popularity that people 
would talk about it for years to come.
